name: Hidden Pond Resort & Tree Spa
insider_take: This enchanting resort feels like a secret forest retreat where luxury meets wilderness, complete with treehouses and a world-class spa nestled among towering pines.
whats_special: Hidden Pond is one of the few resorts in New England offering authentic treehouse accommodations alongside luxury cottages. The property spans 60 acres of pristine Maine forest, and their Tree Spa is literally built around living trees. You're also just minutes from Kennebunkport's famous Dock Square and the scenic coastline where President Bush's family compound sits.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments early morning or late afternoon when natural light filters through the tree canopy for the most magical experience. The treehouse suites book up months in advance for peak summer season.
dont_miss: The resort's farm-to-table restaurant sources ingredients from their own gardens, and the evening s'mores by the fire pits create an unforgettable Maine wilderness experience. Take the complimentary shuttle to nearby Gooch's Beach or explore the charming boutiques in Kennebunkport village.
pros: Luxurious tree house-style accommodations with private outdoor spaces
Award-winning Tree Spa offering unique wellness treatments
Prime Kennebunkport location near beaches and coastal attractions
Farm-to-table dining with exceptional culinary experiences
cons: Adults-only property not suitable for families with children
